title: Universal Future-Technology Orchestrator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Routes a technology-development goal through relevant research agents, databases, engineering tools, simulations, and verification systems. A proposed orchestrator for the whole innovation pipeline: given a technology-development goal, it routes the work through the relevant research agents, databases, engineering tools, simulations, and verification systems — coordinating the handoffs, tracking progress, and ensuring verification happens before anything is declared working. It is the conductor; the other 99 tools are the orchestra.
